text: At key lengths 27 to 29 the known letters fix almost every key slot. The few free slots are filled by trying all 26 letters and keeping whatever makes the reading most like English.
Repeated with one alphabet rebuilt from a puzzle word and the other standard or the sculpture's: 2,232 climbs.
The best reading scores like noise, and the same climb on a shuffled copper does just as well. With so few free slots there is nothing to overfit, and nothing to find.
